contract: POST /api/storage/test diagnoses the current namespace's external payload storage policy. Without a policy it is 422 external_storage_not_configured with a null driver; with a disabled policy it is 422 external_storage_disabled; a requested driver other than the configured one is 422 storage_driver_unavailable naming the supported local diagnostic driver. Laravel validation refuses missing, non-integer, out-of-range and unknown-driver fields with 422 validation_failed and the published messages and error counts. With an enabled local policy it writes, reads back and removes a generated small and large payload, reporting each one's size, SHA-256 and the digest of its content-addressed object URI under the configured root; the diagnostic can run again over the same objects. Other drivers need separate fixtures. Embedded applications have no HTTP diagnostic.
